_comment: Automatic checks the runner shows at the gates (scripts/run-pipeline.js). Human-editable; they inform the reviewer and never approve anything. See docs/review-gates.md, Gate 2.
_scope_coverage_comment: Gate 2 (and the lite consolidated gate): every acceptance criterion and every risk should have at least one approved case; a skip case with its reason counts as an accepted risk. "warn" names the gaps in the brief; "block" keeps the gate closed until there are none.
